source_title: Whirlpool WRF540 counter-depth platform (Water Filter EDR4RXD1)
filter_location_text: Whirlpool WRF540 counter-depth French-door models use an interior everydrop Filter 4 cartridge behind the fresh-food compartment access panel.
replacement_steps_summary: Whirlpool support guidance for EDR4RXD1: remove the old filter cartridge, install the new everydrop Filter 4 until seated, flush several gallons, then reset the filter indicator.
cautions: Whirlpool recommends genuine everydrop filters; interior-dispenser EDR4RXD1 models may require a bypass cap when no filter is installed.
notes: Tier 1 Whirlpool bundle for WRF540CWHZ — WRF540 counter-depth platform Filter Details on whirlpool.com list Water Filter Part Number EDR4RXD1; WRF540CWHZ is the fingerprint-resistant stainless SKU in this family.
